newsitem.title: UK: European airport slot trade to be legalised - FT.
newsitem.headline: European airport slot trade to be legalised - FT.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to recommend legalising the buying and selling of airport take-off and landing slots, currently traded by airlines in a grey market, the Financial Times said in its Friday edition.

The paper said the Commission is expected to recommend changes to EU slot regulations by the end of the year. It said European Union officials said the body is working towards "regularising existing practice" and establising new rules for congested airports throughout the European Union.
Slots frequently change hands for some financial consideration, although the actual price is difficult to ascertain, the FT said.
It reported one London aviation lawyer as saying one pair of peak-hour Heathrow airport slots sold for $1.0 million.
Exchanging slots, which are granted at a twice-yearly meeting hosted by the International Air Transport Association, is legal provided no money changes hands, the paper added.
